text: [issue by yeichong] 1.21-2.2.32-neoforge 手动放进装罐器的能工作，但是AE无法发配进去 [comment by HowXu (none)] has reproduced, trying to.solve now [comment by HowXu (none)] Seems there is no need to work with code. I have checked the ME Canner.java, it is **implements IGridTickable, ICraftingMachine, IGenericInvHost**, means it has a group of features like Molecular Assembler. And here is the if else of pattern judgement ```java else if (this.mode == CanerMode.EMPTY) { if (inputs.length == 1 && patternDetails.getOutputs().size() == 2) { ``` It means, you should add one empty bucket in the output slot, and the empty bucket will be automatically pulled in ME network. Then it works correctly. However, I think this should be displayed in the Guide Book, or it will easily cause misunderstanding. [comment by GlodBlock (owner)] 需要在输出里写上空桶
